title: Geometric structure-preserving parametric finite element approximations for the constrained Helfrich flow
summary: We propose a structure-preserving parametric finite element method for the constrained Helfrich flow of closed curves and surfaces. The proposed method is based on a two-stage velocity-splitting strategy. In the first stage, the normal velocity is computed from a curvature evolution equation, with the volume and surface area constraints imposed softly in terms of the normal velocity. This step approximates the gradient-flow structure of the Helfrich flow, and its fully discrete parametric finite element approximation leads to a linear system and yields an unconditional energy dissipation…
